senses.gloss: गुर् (I) vi. 6Ā (pp. गूर्ण) To make an effort or exertion.
गुर् (II) vt. 4Ā (pp. गूर्ण) 1. To kill, to injure; 2. to go.
गुरण n. Effort, porseverance.
गूरण n. See गुरण.

गुरु (I) a. (f. रु or र्वी; compar. गरीयस्, super. गरिष्ठ) 1. Heavy, weighty, Rt.i.7, R.xii.102; 2. great, large, extended; 3. difficult, arduous, कांताविरहगुरुणा Megh.i.1, तेन धूर्जगतो गुर्वी सचिवेषु निचिक्षिपे R.i.34, ii.35; 4. violent, excessive, गुरुः प्रहर्षः प्रबभूवनात्मनि R.iii.17, Bg.vi.22; 5. important, momentous, स्वार्थात् सतां गुरुतरा प्रणयिक्रियैव Vikr.iv.; 6. long (in duration), गुरुषु दिवसेष्वेषु गच्छत्सु Megh.ii.20; 7. best, excellent; 8. dear, beloved; 9. venerable, respectable; 10. haughty, proud (as a speech); 11. (a syallable) long by nature or position (as मा in मान् or म in मत्सर); it is usually represented by the letter ग (in prosody), e.g. अगुरुचतुष्कं भवति गुरू द्वौ घनकुचयुग्मे शशिवदनाऽसौ Sr.B.

गुरु (II) m. 1. A father, स राज्यं गुरुणा दत्तं प्रतिपद्याधिकं बभौ R.iv.1, iii.31, 48; 2. any venerable or respectable person, an elderly relative, गुरुजनभयमद्विलोकनांतःसमुदयदाकुलभावमुद्वहंत्या Bh.V.ii.7, 18, 19, 49, Bg.ii.5; 3. a teacher, a preceptor; 4. a spiritual preceptor, a religious teacher, तौ दंपती वसिष्ठस्य गुरोर्जग्मतुराश्रमम् R.i.35, 57, especially one who performs purificatory ceremonies over a boy and initiates him into the sacred lore, Yaj.i.34; 5. head, chief, गुरुर्नृपाणां गुरवे निवेद्य R.ii.68; 6. the constellation called Pushya; 7. the propounder of a new doctrine; 8. name of Bṛhaspati, the preceptor of gods; 9. the planet Jupiter, गुरुकाव्यानुगां बिभ्रच्चांद्रीमभिनभःश्रियम् Sis.ii.2; 10. an epithet of Droṇa, the teacher of the Pāṇḍavas and Kauravas; 11. an epithet of Prabhākara, the leader of that school of the Mīmānsākas which goes by his name.

गुर्विणी f. A pregnant woman, e.g. गुर्वुणीं नानुगच्छंति न स्पृशंति रजस्वलाम्.
गुरु-अर्थ m. a preceptor’s fee for instructing a pupil, गुर्वर्थमाहर्तमहं यतिष्ये R.v.17.
गुरु-उत्तम (I) a. highly revered.
गुरु-उत्तम (II) m. the supreme soul.
गुरु-कार m. worship, adoration.
गुरु-क्रम m. instruction handed down to a series of teachers, traditional instruction.
गुरु-जन m. any venerable person, an elderly relative, Bh.V.ii.7.
गुरु-तल्प, -तल्पग, -तल्पिन् m. 1. one who defiles his step-mother; 2. a violator of his preceptor’s bed. (these are regarded as अतिपातकानि in Hindu religious law), M.xi.103.
गुरु-तल्प, -तल्पग, -तल्पिन् m. 1. one who defiles his step-mother; 2. a violator of his preceptor’s bed. (these are regarded as अतिपातकानि in Hindu religious law), M.xi.103.
गुरु-तल्प, -तल्पग, -तल्पिन् m. 1. one who defiles his step-mother; 2. a violator of his preceptor’s bed. (these are regarded as अतिपातकानि in Hindu religious law), M.xi.103.
गुरु-दक्षिणा f. fee given to a spiritual preceptor.
गुरु-दैवत m. the constellation Pushya.
गुरु-पाक a. difficult of digestion.
गुरु-भ n. 1. the constellation Pushya; 2. a bow.
गुरु-मर्दल m. a kind of drum or tabor.
गुरु-रत्न n. a topaz.
गुरु-लाघव n. relative importance or value.
गुरु-वर्तिन् m. a bachelor who resides at his preceptor’s house.
गुरु-वासर m. Thursday.
गुरु-वृत्ति f. the conduct of a pupil towards his preceptor.
गुरुक a. (f. की) A little heavy.
गुरुक a. (f. की) A little heavy.
गु(गू)र्जर m. 1. The district of Gujarāth; 2. a native of Gujarāth, तेषां मार्गे परिचयवशादर्जितं गुर्जराणां यः संतापं शिथिलमकरोत्सोनमाथं विलोक्य Vikr.Ch.xviii.97.
